You can also create your
own functions, which can be
defined with any letter (except
for the special ones, like
x,y,r, t, and e). Your custom
functions can then be used like
any other function on this list.
For example, if you type f(x) =
x^2, you can then graph y =
f(x+1), which
is the same
parabola but
shifted over
to the left:
